cases: a settled prior reconnect refusal is detected by issue code or the reconnect goodbye
in-progress, user-stopped, successful, create-time unavailable, and unreadable history rows are not treated as a repeat
the first refusal keeps the existing retryable goodbye
a repeated refusal does not invite an immediate retry and is not marked retryable
a subsequent attempt still reconnects the same recorded identity
admin-only recovery reasons stay off the live report, the persisted conversation record, and the GET reopen, including on the repeated goodbye
a pre-timer Surplus scope call recorded after the build timer starts is not reported as a zero-second first call
limitations: not a replay of a customer build
no proof of an actual provider capacity incident
